name: Danaher Front Headlock System
description: John Danaher’s The Front Headlock System covers standing entries, guillotines, anacondas, darces, go-behinds and front-headlock guard passing.
summary: Front-headlock entries, positional control and attacks across standing, kneeling, seated and guard-passing situations.
overview:
The Front Headlock System by John Danaher connects entries and control with both submission and positional options. Its eight volumes cover standing, kneeling and seated exchanges, with a separate guard-passing section.

Alongside guillotines, anacondas and darces, the course includes go-behinds and cradles. Its breadth suits grapplers who want the front headlock to serve more than one finishing option.

products.title: The Front Headlock System
products.blurb: Eight volumes covering front-headlock entries, control, submissions and positional advances.
products.best_for: Grapplers building a front-headlock game beyond a single guillotine finish.

fits: You want front-headlock entries and positional options as well as choke finishes.
You use the front headlock in both standing exchanges and seated or passing situations.

includes: Reactive entries, snapdowns and transitions from standing front headlock to the mat.
Guillotine, anaconda and darce variations, cradles and go-behinds.
Seated front headlocks, hip heists and applications against seated guard and half guard.
limits: The course follows front-headlock exchanges; it is not a complete turtle-riding or general guard-passing course.
